title: AC1024 version-2 inline constraint-group parser control
scope: Decode a bounded AC1024 version-2 inline node sequence using the peer-derived R2010 field order while keeping unsupported classes, ambiguous registry layouts, native semantics, and version-2 output unqualified.

peerEvidence.fixtureProvenance: Hand-encoded synthetic data generated by examples/generate_r2010_inline_constraint_fixture.rs; not a native producer drawing.
peerEvidence.nativeValidationLimit: The peer's separate AutoCAD 2027 issue-135 corpus covers AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 groups, but does not authenticate this exact two-node synthetic fixture or its producer path.

implementedProfile.admission: A positive bounded node count is considered inline. For a nonzero next-node-ID seed, the candidate count is probed without consuming the stream unless it is positive. The candidate is complete only when supported node classes parse, all body/handle fields remain bounded, the body reaches its exact end, and the detached string tail is fully consumed.
nodeFields: bounded connection count and node IDs
version-2 active flag for decoded geometrical and explicit constraints
rawOnlyCases: zero node count with nonzero seed, which may be a registered layout
incomplete handle, body, or detached-string span

generatedControls.description: From-scratch AC1024 object frames exercise six sparse node IDs, distinct status bytes, reciprocal connection IDs, a bounded-line geometry dependency, an active fixed constraint, distance and radius/diameter dependency handles, and vertical/horizontal datum-line indexes. True and false active values are checked for geometrical, distance, radius/diameter, vertical and horizontal node bodies. A separate control omits the required fixed-constraint active bit and requires raw-only publication plus following-object recovery.
generatedControls.activeBitPlacement: The generator emits each version-2 active bit after the implied bit and before the following class-specific direction/mode/datum field, matching the reader's peer-derived candidate order.
generatedControls.copyPreservation: The parsed node status and active flag survive DRW_AssociativeObject copy construction.
generatedControls.outputPolicy: The existing DWG-to-DXF writer admission requires m_constraintGroupVersion == 0; version-2 output remains refused.
